rows.source: Given the API base URL is "https://api.stockbroker.test"
rows.action: Set the API base URL to "https://api.stockbroker.test"

rows.source:
When a POST request is sent to "/v1/orders" with body:
{
  "clientId": "TRD1001",
  "symbol": "AAPL",
  "side": "BUY",
  "type": "MARKET",
  "quantity": 10
}
rows.sourceExpected:
Then the response status code is 201
And the response body field "status" is "FILLED"
And the response matches the schema "schemas/order-response.json"
rows.action:
Send a POST request to "/v1/orders" with this body:
{
  "clientId": "TRD1001",
  "symbol": "AAPL",
  "side": "BUY",
  "type": "MARKET",
  "quantity": 10
}
rows.expected:
Response status code is 201
Response body field "status" is "FILLED"
Response matches the schema "schemas/order-response.json"
